<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a crafting material, at their most basic being the least efficient source for fuel; {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}|10}} -> {{Item|Fuel|20}}. Alternatively, they can be used in various building and crafting applications, such as being required to craft most tools. They are one of the few materials that cannot be crafted themselves; they must either be gathered from bushes (bushes give 2x), collected when cutting down trees (normal trees gives 1-2x, small trees gives 4x), or purchased from the wood vendor [[Tress]].
{{Quote|Perfect for poking people and starting fires.|In-Game Description}}
